hypothesis: The compact U-Net adds complementary information to the fixed hybrid when given a small fixed contribution.
design: Chosen after inspecting the original models' development diagnostics, before evaluating this combination. Not an independent holdout.
input_stage: Final archived nonnegative rainfall maps in mm/day; not unbounded anomalies.
arithmetic: float64, no additional clipping, rounding, normalization or bias correction
sources: Unchanged spatial_unet_v1 information cutoffs and source snapshots
primary_metric: RMSE pooled over all 168 months and the full 301 by 261 grid
interpretation: Describe complementary errors and temporal/regional consistency. No significance claim or automatic promotion. No new forecasts are issued.
